verdict.rationale: Pipedream scopes MCP access per app: each app gets its own dedicated MCP server, selected via the x-pd-app-slug header. That lets a developer limit which app/server an agent connects to. However, the docs show tools being auto-loaded wholesale, and Conduit's 'security' claim is too vague to count as an access-control feature. Missing for 10: explicit server allowlists, per-tool allow/deny or access-control policies, admin/gateway policy documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
